The description names no fill-level check, no capacity check, no device connection and no app launch step, and it states no parallel activity. The missing elements M2, M3, M7 and M14 therefore come from reference content that the description does not support, so no guideline should require them. The remaining differences (P1 gateway label, P2 and P3/P4 label wording) are wording variants of elements the generator already modeled. Gateway labeling from the description's own criterion is already covered by LRN-067 and GW-02, so no new guideline is supported by these records.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states, in one sentence, that one actor performs two distinct actions joined by 'and': Model each of the two actions as its own task, labeled with the action the description names, in the order the description gives, connected by a sequence flow. Do not combine them into a single task, even when the actions are closely related or the label of one of them is a broad summary.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one actor must supply several distinct items of information in a single clause, before a later step of the process, for example as a list joined by 'and'

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a participant must press one or more controls, and that a system step then retrieves data from an external device and presents it to that participant: Model each press of a control as its own user task performed by that participant, placed before the system activity it triggers. Model the retrieval and presentation of device data as a separate service task placed after the press that starts it. Do not merge the press and the system retrieval into one activity, and do not leave the press implicit in the system step.
